name: Wight
resistances: necrotic; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical, nonsilvered weapons
languages: The languages it knew in life
notes: CR 3. Speaks. Life Drain creates zombie thralls. Undead.
gm_notes: Session 1 Altar Chamber (guardian). He does not attack immediately -- he is waiting. Speaks if party tries to take the spear. DC 14 Persuasion with contract scroll (advantage) may pause combat. Life Drain: DC 13 CON save or HP max reduced by damage. Humanoid killed rises as zombie under wight's control. Session 5 also appears.
